descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S17 Purge at scale: 501 charts on one account and 20 accounts at once, all aged 37 h

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 The purge runs on the server: records clear at their window whether or not any device has the app open. (TFA-94699 AC 7; UAT 3.7 (retention claim)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Records clear exactly at their window: each item is still present just before its window ends and gone just after it. (UAT OAT-04 Expected 1; TFA-94699 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given One physician with 501 synthetic Hospital patients and 20 physicians with 50 each; every chart's vitals, labs and medication rows aged 37 h. Controls: 10 of the 20 accounts and chart #501 of the large account also hold fresh items (vitals recorded 1 h ago, an open task on a chart processed 2 h ago)

When One purge cycle runs (the server job; on main the client-called applyLifecycle)

Then Every aged item on every chart is gone after one cycle, including chart #501; every control item is still there; each applyLifecycle call (or the server job) returns without throwing and the local Convex log has no read/write-limit error; the cycle time is recorded

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Completeness from OAT-04 Expected 1 and TFA-94699 AC 7: any chart still holding aged data after the cycle (or after the agreed lag, Q1) = Fail; chart #501 holding aged data after one cycle = Fail; any control item missing = Fail (deleted too early or on the wrong account); a thrown call or a limit error in the local Convex log = Fail. …

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94699 in progress

With 501 patients on one account, one purge pass leaves the 501st chart's 37 h-old labs and medication rows in place until another pass.

Evidence: allure 8cd2bac5-…-result.json; retention lane, isolated backend. 5 checks pass, 2 fail, known K13 (applyLifecycle reads at most 500 charts per call). Time is recorded only (2.4 s for the large account).

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane retention.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: PERF · Performance timing — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: retention.
